clues.text: This city sits on the west coast of Greenland, on the Davis Strait. It lies far north of Nuuk, the capital of Greenland.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside the west coast of Greenland

source.quote: It is located in central-western Greenland, on the coast of Davis Strait, approximately 320 km (200 mi) north of Nuuk.

clues.text: Even in the cold far north, this port stays free of ice all year round. No port north of here in this land can say the same.
clues.narrowing: rules out far north ports that freeze shut in winter

source.quote: is the northernmost year-round ice-free port in the country

clues.text: People have lived at this site for four thousand five hundred years. First came the Saqqaq, then the Dorset, then the Thule folk.
clues.narrowing: rules out west Greenland towns without this long chain of early cultures

source.quote: The site has been inhabited for the last 4,500 years, first by peoples of the Saqqaq culture, then Dorset culture, and then the Thule people

clues.text: Its new culture centre was the second one built in all of Greenland. The first one was built in Nuuk, the capital.
clues.narrowing: rules out all but the few Greenland towns with a national culture centre

source.quote: The new Taseralik Culture Centre is the second cultural centre to be established in Greenland, after Katuaq in Nuuk.

clues.text: This is the second largest city in all of Greenland. It is also the main town of the Qeqqata area in the west.
clues.narrowing: converts to the second-largest city in Greenland

source.quote: is the capital and largest city of the Qeqqata municipality, and the second-largest city in Greenland
